intro: Irregularities, conflicts and unverified items. None of these blocks publishing; each one is a reason a value is blank or a claim is qualified. Severity: high = changes the decision, medium = changes the numbers, low = presentation.

rows.title: Las Vegas has no subway or metro — the brief's 'subway or bus' premise cannot be met as written
rows.detail: Rail service is the 7-station Las Vegas Monorail, which runs only along the east side of the Strip. Everything else is RTC bus (including the Deuce on Las Vegas Blvd), walking, the free tram segments, rideshare or car.
rows.effect: The hotel ranking uses on-campus walking plus bus/monorail reachability, not subway travel. Q-03 asks you to accept this.

rows.title: No official door-to-door transit time was retrieved for any hotel→restaurant or hotel→activity pair
rows.detail: The RTC Trip Planner returns live results but was not queried for exact 2027 dates. Monorail headways (4–8 min) and station hours are published; total journey times are not modelled, and modelling would violate the no-inference rule.
rows.effect: Every 'within 1 hour' cell is marked unverified. The ranking therefore uses MICHELIN restaurants inside the same resort (walking) as the discriminating measure.

rows.title: Every hotel total excludes taxes
rows.detail: Flamingo, Paris, Caesars Palace and South Point all display rates 'excluding taxes'. None of the captured pages state the tax amount, so no tax-inclusive total exists anywhere on this site. A prior session cited a Clark County room tax of '~13.38%' and a Venetian all-in total containing $728.18 of tax; neither was confirmed from an official Nevada tax source in this session.
rows.effect: 7-night totals understate the final bill. Q-20 and S-01 cover closing this.

rows.title: Resort-fee figures conflict between rate cards and fee disclosures
rows.detail: Caesars Palace and Paris: rate cards add a '$55 daily resort fee' while the fee disclosure says $62.30 with tax ($54.95 + $7.35) — the first is pre-tax. Flamingo: $50 on the rate card, $56.63 with tax in the disclosure. South Point: the booking engine says $29.20/day while the hotel's own rate page said $33/night (logged by a prior session). Independently corroborated 2026-11-27 (session c88d116c): the same $55 rate-card vs $62.30-with-tax disclosure at Caesars Palace.
rows.effect: Fee-inclusive comparisons are consistent only at the pre-tax level, which is what the totals use. South Point's two fee statements remain unreconciled.

source.label: Caesars Palace rate page + fee disclosure
South Point guest rooms / rate page

rows.title: The Venetian and Palazzo serve no dated rate to the fetch tool
rows.detail: The official booking calendar for Feb 15–22, 2027 rendered '$XXX' on every date. A prior session logged $6,170.43 all-in for the same seven nights, but that figure could not be reproduced on 2026-11-27.
rows.effect: The densest MICHELIN hotel on the list has no ranked price. The prior figure is shown as unverified provenance only.

rows.title: MGM Resorts booking platform did not load
rows.detail: Requests to the MGM booking results path failed for MGM Grand, Cosmopolitan, Bellagio and ARIA.
rows.effect: Four Strip hotels have no room detail or rate. They are listed for their MICHELIN clusters only.

rows.title: Two-queen rate captured at only three of eleven hotels
rows.detail: Flamingo ($83/night), Paris ($203/night) and South Point ($141/night) have verified two-queen rates. Caesars Palace's two-queen room exists on the official room list but only the king rate was served.
rows.effect: Bed-for-bed comparison is incomplete; Caesars Palace is compared on a king room.

rows.title: 2026 MICHELIN awards are not a 2027 guarantee
rows.detail: The list used is the 2026 MICHELIN Guide Southwest selection (24 Las Vegas distinctions). The 2027 selection has not been announced.
rows.effect: Every award cell is labelled 2026. Recheck before booking a restaurant-led trip.

rows.title: Wing Lei is Recommended in the 2026 guide — not starred
rows.detail: The official Wynn page advertises Forbes Five-Star but no MICHELIN star. The official Las Vegas MICHELIN list places Wing Lei in the 'Recommended by MICHELIN Guide' group. Earlier third-party reports had it starred.
rows.effect: Wing Lei is counted as a listed restaurant, not a star, everywhere on this site.

rows.title: Restaurant hours are missing for most rows, and two venues have conflicting hours across sources
rows.detail: Verified: Joël Robuchon (Tue–Sat), Wing Lei (closed Tue–Wed), Bouchon (full weekly grid), Sparrow and Wolf, China Poblano and Stubborn Seed (full grids captured 2026-11-27); é and L'Atelier by a prior logged session. Partial: Esther's Kitchen (Tue–Sun, full grid uncaptured). Guy Savoy publishes no weekly grid. The other 14 rows have no verified hours. Yen Viet Kitchen and Pho Ga Bac Bac have documented conflicts between their own sites and other listings; the Sparrow and Wolf conflict was resolved from its official site (2026-11-27).
rows.effect: The Hours column is blank (not guessed) for those rows. Day-by-day planning is not yet possible for them.

rows.title: Two-person menu totals are published for only one MICHELIN restaurant
rows.detail: Partage publishes $130 / $160 / $210 per person. Guy Savoy publishes à-la-carte items ($60–$290). Sparrow and Wolf, China Poblano and Stubborn Seed publish à-la-carte menus with item ranges but no two-person total (captured 2026-11-27). The other 19 restaurants do not publish a two-person total on the pages captured.
rows.effect: The 'Cost for 2' column shows an exact total only for Partage; à-la-carte anchors are noted where published (Guy Savoy, Sparrow and Wolf, China Poblano, Stubborn Seed). No estimate is invented.

rows.title: Official social accounts could be verified for only a few venues
rows.detail: The Neon Museum links its Instagram, TikTok and Facebook in its own footer; Caesars Palace links Instagram, Facebook, X and YouTube; the Monorail links @lvmonorail. Handles for the other restaurants and activities could not be confirmed from an official page.
rows.effect: The social column is blank for those rows and a clearly-labelled YouTube search link is offered instead. No handle is guessed.

source.label: Neon Museum official visit page (footer socials)

rows.title: The brief's trip length conflicts with itself
rows.detail: Preferred window Feb 15–18, 2027 = 3 nights; the cost basis requested is 7 nights; the allowed range is 1–2 weeks.
rows.effect: This site prices 7 nights and shows 3 nights only as the preferred-date reference. Q-01 asks for one answer.

rows.title: Feb 15, 2027 is Washington's Birthday (a federal holiday)
rows.detail: Check-in on the preferred date is a holiday Monday, verified against the OPM federal holiday calendar by a prior session.
rows.effect: Expect holiday demand and higher weekend-adjacent rates; consider a Feb 16–17 check-in.

rows.title: South Point has no availability for Mar 15–22, 2027 because Mar 20 is sold out
rows.detail: The engine returned 'We do not have available rooms on March 20, 2027' for that seven-night window.
rows.effect: March availability is already constrained at some properties even before the 2027 event calendar is considered.

rows.title: Activity prices and hours are missing for ten of fourteen venues
rows.detail: Verified: High Roller prices and hours; Shark Reef hours and tiers; Fremont Street show schedule (free canopy shows); Bellagio Fountains schedule (free); Mob Museum hours; Neon Museum hours (+ 2027 from-price); Bellagio Conservatory show dates. Not captured: Sphere's Feb 2027 programme; KÀ showtimes and prices; Venetian gondola pricing; Omega Mart hours/price; Hoover Dam tours; Red Rock Canyon and Valley of Fire fees and hours; Mob, Neon and Conservatory ticket prices.
rows.effect: Those cells are blank. Bellagio's own page does list a $135 brunch and $210 dinner for The Garden Table, but only through Jan 2, 2027 — outside your window, so it is not counted.

rows.title: The Monorail does not reach Chinatown, Downtown or off-Strip restaurants
rows.detail: The seven Monorail stations are Strip-only. 12 of the 24 MICHELIN restaurants are in Chinatown, Downtown or off-Strip locations.
rows.effect: Half the restaurant list requires bus, rideshare or car from any Strip hotel; Chinatown has no rail link.

rows.title: Repository publishes seven overlapping trip sites
rows.detail: The repo contained 78 HTML pages across the root dashboard, docs/ (nine pages plus four session folders), planner-v1, legacy-dashboard, field-notes and site/*. Seven different 'final' versions existed, each claiming to be the planner.
rows.effect: This session consolidated the root into one canonical site and preserved the previous sites under docs/. See the Repo review page.

rows.title: A preserved prior README states there are 'three starred restaurants' — the official list has four
rows.detail: README.md line ~121 (text inherited from the first dashboard) says the 2026 search found three starred restaurants. The official Las Vegas MICHELIN page states four starred restaurants (5 stars): Joël Robuchon 2, L'Atelier 1, Guy Savoy 1, é by José Andrés 1.
rows.effect: The preserved text was left untouched as a historical record; this site uses the official count of four everywhere.

rows.title: GitHub Pages deployment configuration is ambiguous
rows.detail: The Pages API reports build_type 'legacy' with source main at '/', while .github/workflows/pages.yml deploys the docs/ folder as a Pages artifact. Those are two different publishing paths; the docs/ artifact deployment does not change the fact that the live root comes from the repository root.
rows.effect: This session therefore publishes at the root (where the live site actually is) and preserves earlier work under docs/. The workflow was left intact.

rows.title: Two pull requests from earlier sessions remain open and unmerged
rows.detail: PR #8 (arena/0f0e637a-vegas2) and PR #9 (arena/fd2715d0-vegas2) are still open. Neither is required for this site.
rows.effect: Left open and untouched; they do not conflict with the root pages claimed by this session.

rows.title: Fees captured from one engine may differ from checkout
rows.detail: Deposits, incidentals and parking surcharges are stated per property (Caesars $100/day deposit, Flamingo $50/day, self-parking surcharge) but were not added to any total.
rows.effect: Totals are room + resort fee only. Deposits are refundable and excluded deliberately.

rows.title: Dated hotel rates moved between two captures one day apart
rows.detail: Caesars Palace, Feb 15–22 2027, three readings logged within 24 hours: Julius Deluxe 1 King $226/night → $1,582 for 7 nights (2026-11-26); the same Julius room $214/night → $1,498 (2026-11-27); Room Type Assigned on Arrival $209/night → $1,463 (2026-11-27), while a second capture of the assigned-on-arrival room logged $226 → $1,582. A 5.6% move on the same room in 24 hours.
rows.effect: Every price on this site is a reading with a timestamp, and even same-day readings differ. A booking decision needs a fresh capture on the day you book, plus a free-cancellation hold as a hedge.
